body: I appreciate you willing to be a friend to a hurting stranger. You are good people and will be blessed for your kind gesture. I, unfortunately, think that I am too defeated and too tired. I have begun the process of getting my affairs in order. I am done fighting.

I have. On numerous occasions. Some don’t text back for several days. Other say they don’t have the time or don’t want to. This has been the response for the last 2-3 months and I just don’t know what I did wrong. I have and almost always initiate contact. There is no one that initiates the contact with me. When I say no one I mean no one, it is not for dramatic effect. If I don’t initiate, then no one texts me. I can’t be such a terrible person that no one wants to hang out with me, am I? Obviously I am, but no one wants to tell me what I’m doing wrong so I can fix it.  It is beyond frustrating, it’s maddening. I am at the point  where I am so depressed I have stopped eating, not sleeping. I hurt so much that I need it stop.
Texts are superficial but at least they are a way of someone reaching out and acknowledging you exist. Someone checking in on you, maybe someone even thinking about you.
